text_block_list.text: One day in the Trainer's Office—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's almost time for training.
Whatever the workout is, I'll ace it!
(Knock knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Pardon me before we begin training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I have some big news!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Trainer-san's remarkable performance
has been extremely well-received by those at the URA—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: We received word that they'd like to invite us to the banquet!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh, isn't that amazing?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Well, this is all thanks to the King being so brilliant!
I'll grant you the right to thank me!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Plus, apparently it's a high-class party held at a three-star hotel!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I hear everything from attire to dining etiquette is strictly judged,
so this sounds like it'll be a valuable experience!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To be invited to a party like that,
congratulations, really~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh~... A dinner banquet at a three-star hotel, huh~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the dinner will be top-notch too!
I wonder what kind of menu they'll serve?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hey, what are you getting so flustered about?

I explained that I hadn't acquired the table manners
needed to survive a formal banquet.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I see.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fine then, come along with me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Knife, fork, charger plate...
Yep, everything is ready.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well then, first unfold your napkin.
choice_data_list: What are you planning to do...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What does it look like? It's table manners training.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're nervous about the banquet, aren't you?
That's why I'm gonna train you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Didn't I tell you earlier? I'm first-class, so I can handle anything.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now that you understand, stop spacing out
and let me drill some manners into you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, once you're done eating, place your knife and fork together...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all good. I think you've pretty much
grasped all the basic etiquette now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's not something so big that you need
to thank me so formally.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because King is first-class!
Of course knowing this level of manners is second nature to me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because King is first-class!
Of course knowing this level of manners is second nature to me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! Hurry up and become a first-rate
Trainer worthy of serving me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, I believe you owe me a slice of cake
as a thank-you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm ordering the frilly cake,
it's such a treat for the eyes too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Would you please prepare Orange Pekoe tea for me?
I will accept nothing else!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: O-ho-ho-ho!

Pushing King Halo's high-born pride too far
was proving to be dangerous.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, I used to go to places like that
often ever since I was little, so...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, hold on a second!What do you mean, 'actually'?!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Don't tell me you didn't believe I was first-class?!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sit right back down in that seat! I will make you
realize once and for all that I am truly first-class!

And so, the Advanced Table Manners course
began...
